title: Release Train - Weekly Prep Notes (2026-04-08)
content:
Context: Prep notes for weekly release train sync (Thu 2026-04-08). Primary goal: confirm go/no-go decisions for next minor launch (v1.14) and surface any last-minute blockers. This is a personal prep/scratchpad; will tidy up post-meeting and send meeting notes.

Meeting logistics:
- Time: Thu 2026-04-08 10:00-10:45 PT
- Attendees (expected): Release leads, SRE on-call, QA lead, Product PM, Eng owners for serving/runtime and console
- Objective: Final readiness check and owners for remaining actions; confirm canary schedule and rollback plan.

Agenda draft:
1) Quick status round (2-3 mins per team)
2) Go/no-go checklist walk-through (15 mins)
3) Risk signals & mitigation (10 mins)
4) Action items and owners (5-10 mins)
5) Canary schedule and monitoring runbook confirmation (if go)

Go / No-Go Checklist (status notes + owners):
- Infra capacity (GPU pools & autoscale) - Owner: Arjun Mehta - STATUS: GREEN
  Notes: Dedicated pools sized +10% over forecast; autoscale tests passed on dev; residual concern: one EC2 instance family has delayed firmware patch but fallback pool available.

- Model binary validation & perf (latency/p99) - Owner: Olivia Martin - STATUS: AMBER
  Notes: Perf tests on staging show p99 ~ 1.25x target for long-context flows (>8k). Root cause likely kernel selection mismatch for that model variant. Mitigation: pin older kernel path for canary, open ticket to vendor kernels. Need decision: proceed with canary pinned to lower-latency variant?

- Quality/regression checks (eval sets, smoke prompts) - Owner: Samir Patel - STATUS: GREEN
  Notes: No regressions flagged on key prompts; small drift on prompt set "account-summaries" - scoring down 0.8% (within threshold).

- Data/privacy & PII scanning - Owner: Priya Kapoor - STATUS: GREEN
  Notes: Static checks complete; runtime PII redaction hooks enabled in canary. Confirm logging config off for customer data in canary.

- Canary rollout automation & metrics hooks - Owner: Zara Ali - STATUS: GREEN
  Notes: Runbook linked; SLO alert thresholds prepped. Need final confirmation from SRE on alert routes.

- Observability & tracing (token-level latency + error traces) - Owner: Miguel Santos - STATUS: GREEN
  Notes: Dashboards updated; synthetic trace generator ready.

- Rollback plan & burn-the-ship tests - Owner: Arjun Mehta - STATUS: GREEN
  Notes: Automated rollback validated in staging; manual rollback steps documented in runbook.

- Customer communications & support readiness - Owner: Emily Rivera (CS) - STATUS: AMBER
  Notes: Draft announcement ready; support playbook needs one final pass for known issues (model drift fallback behaviour). Emily to confirm by EOD Wed.

Open blockers / Questions (to surface in meeting):
- Q1: Olivia - can we pin canary to older kernel variant without impacting compatibility for model features? Action: Olivia to confirm timeline and compatibility by meeting.
- Q2: SRE - confirm alert paging & escalation for canary spikes (who is primary on-call?). Action: SRE to confirm and share on-call roster.
- Q3: CS - final approval on customer messaging; we should include a note about potential short-term latency differences for long-context workloads.

Action items (owner + due):
- Olivia: Decide on kernel pinning for canary and add config to canary manifest (due: 2026-04-08 12:00 PT).
- Arjun: Verify fallback pool capacity and confirm firmware patch plan (due: 2026-04-09).
- Priya: Re-run PII smoke tests against canary config and confirm logging off (due: 2026-04-08 15:00 PT).
- Samir: Run extended regression job with account-summaries prompt set overnight and surface any new failures (due: 2026-04-09 09:00 PT).
- Emily: Finalize support playbook & announcement copy; confirm readiness (due: 2026-04-08 17:00 PT).
- Miguel: Verify dashboards include the synthetic trace and attach sample alerts to the runbook (due: 2026-04-08 11:00 PT).
- Zara (me): Publish meeting notes, update runbook link in the ticket, and coordinate canary start time after meeting (due: 2026-04-08 EOB).

Monitoring signals to watch during canary (quick checklist):
- p50/p95/p99 latency by route (esp long-context routes)
- error rate by model variant and host
- memory/GPU utilization and OOM events
- logging volume (to ensure redaction hooks working)
- token-level cost spikes (unexpected billing anomalies)

Fallback / contingency plan (if amber/red persists in meeting):
- Option A: Delay canary by 24-48h to address kernel/perf; communicate delay to stakeholders and shift rollout window.
- Option B (soft go): Canary with <5% traffic pinned to lower-latency model variant + extended monitoring and immediate rollback threshold at 2x error rate or 1.5x p99 latency.

Notes to self (post-meeting follow-up):
- Tidy up canary manifest and attach exact config diff to JIRA-RT-1023.
- Add kernel-selection note to runbook and link to vendor ticket.
- Remind QA to include additional long-context synthetic failures in next regression run.
- Draft post-launch retrospective template to capture perf/quality tradeoffs for model variant decisions.

Quick links (for meeting):
- Runbook: confluence/release-runbook-2026
- Ticket: JIRA-RT-1023 (canary rollout)
- Perf dashboard: internal-dashboard/redwood/perf-v1-14
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789

End of prep notes. Will convert to meeting notes and send action tracker after sync.
